title: Not good in the dryer
text: Not good in the dryer. I used these to wash my newborn grandsons clothes and other baby stuff and they are horrible in the dryer, the clothes do not dry at all. I had to remove them from the bag and dry them and pray that my dryer didnt eat his tiny little socks, as dryers do, but I was fortunate and they didnt disappear. I think the mesh is too thick.
